definitions.explanation: Emotional or spiritual healing and comfort. Refers to anything that soothes the mind, relieves stress, or provides emotional relief. A popular cultural concept in modern Japan, often associated with relaxation, cute things, nature, and wellness.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{癒|いや}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Pets are a source of comfort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癒|いや}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Soaking in a hot spring is soothing for the mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癒|いや}しだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: In my busy daily life, I feel that walking in nature is the greatest source of healing.

notes:
FORMS:
Noun form of the verb ⟦{癒|いや}す→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧ (to heal, to soothe). The し ending creates a noun expressing the concept or experience of healing.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{癒|いや}し became a buzzword in Japan from the late 1990s onward, reflecting a growing cultural focus on stress relief and emotional well-being. The concept extends to many areas: {癒|いや}し⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (healing-type) is used to describe people, music, spaces, and products that have a calming or comforting effect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {癒|いや}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: healing/relaxing space
- {癒|いや}し⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧: healing-type, soothing (as a personality or aesthetic)
- {癒|いや}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧: healing music
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癒|いや}し: emotional healing
